statements.quote: Overhaul housing via rent control and social housing stock
statements.claim: Names rent control and social housing as a top priority, together with taxing wealth to support climate and education investment and state single payer.

statements.quote: establish single payer healthcare for Maryland
statements.claim: Explicitly supports establishing a Maryland single-payer system.

statements.quote: organize year round in working class neighborhoods
statements.claim: Would use the office's resources and public platform for ongoing community organizing; does not treat his allegations about the incumbent as verified facts.

statements.quote: a list of reasons why we couldn’t get things done
statements.claim: Frames the forum's explanations as evidence of insufficient legislative delivery. This is his campaign assessment, not the study's independent verdict.
Presents Maryland as making progress while defending against conservative federal policies and court decisions.

statements.quote: we will fight again to pass these bills
statements.claim: Promises to re-pursue tenant-protection bills discussed immediately before this quote. The report does not specify every bill, so no rent-control opposition is inferred.

statements.quote: we will have a Democratic governor next year
statements.claim: Connects another attempt at tenant-protection legislation to electing a Democratic governor.

comparisons.analysis: Socol names rent control and social housing as an overhaul; Waldstreicher emphasizes another attempt to pass previously pursued tenant protections. The retained opponent quote does not establish his position on every specific Socol proposal.

Socol presents the legislature as failing to deliver; Waldstreicher presents ongoing progress threatened by conservative federal forces. These are competing campaign narratives, not independent performance measurements.
Socol emphasizes year-round organizing through the office; Waldstreicher emphasizes renewed legislative efforts with a Democratic governor. These strategies need not be mutually exclusive.
